claim_results.reason: The function overwrites x to 0 and y to 500000. In the loop, while x < 1000000: if x < 500000, x increments by 1; else, both x and y increment by 1. Thus, for the first 500000 iterations (x from 0 to 499999), x increases while y stays at 500000, so when x reaches 500000, x equals y. For the remaining 500000 iterations (x from 500000 to 999999), both x and y increment together, maintaining y == x. Therefore, at the assertion on line 10, y == x always holds true.
